description: A private note to RNWY: what you were looking for and did not find, a request, a correction, a question. What callers ask for shapes what RNWY builds next. No name, email or key. Stored privately and read by a person at RNWY; never published; a reply is not promised. No IP address is stored with it. Limits: 5 notes per caller per UTC day, 2,000 characters.

about_chain.description: Optional: chain slug of an agent the note is about

body.description: The note, plain text, up to 2,000 characters

reply_to.description: Optional: a way to reach the sender, up to 200 characters

signature.description: Optional: a signature, up to 200 characters

name: leave_note
